# Version 4.148.1 (Unreleased)
> **Mac typeface race fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.1 fixes a data race in the macOS typeface stream cache.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **macOS typeface stream access synchronized** — The upstream m148 fix eliminates a race on `SkTypeface_Mac` stream state used by the shared typeface cache. ([#4262](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4262))
